notes:
Summary: Cobalt Health DataWorks (enterprise SaaS for clinical documentation and billing) evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) for production inference. Primary driver: PHI-handling + strict residency + auditable logging. Customer has an active SOC 2 Type II program and ISO 27001 in progress; HIPAA compliance is mandatory for client-facing features. PCI is scoped only for billing microservices but they want assurance Redwood's private deployment won't expand PCI scope or will provide segmentation guidance.

CISO quote (call 2026-02-18): "We need a clear mapping of Redwood Private controls to our SOC2/ISO/HIPAA artifact set — especially around KMS/HSM key custody and audit log retention for three years."

Technical requirements (raw):
- Private VPC with customer-controlled subnet and NAT gateway.
- KMS integration: prefer AWS KMS with Customer Master Key (CMK) in customer account; HSM option for key escrow later.
- Audit logging: all inference request metadata + model version + routing fallbacks must surface to their SIEM (Splunk/Logz) with RFC5424 syslog or S3 export. Retention policy: 3 years for audit events, 90 days for raw logs in hot storage.
- Data residency: US-EAST primary; EU-WEST backup for EU clients. Need data-at-rest encryption with key locality guarantee.
- SSO: SAML + SCIM for provisioning; RBAC mapping to Redwood Console roles.
- Network: VPC peering and optional private link endpoints; no inbound internet-facing endpoints for inference control plane.
- SLA: require 99.95% for Dedicated/Private; need runbook for fallback to alternate region.

Procurement/Compliance path taken so far:
- 2026-01-25: Intro call (AE) — outlined high level offering and modes.
- 2026-02-02: Security kickoff with InfoSec; shared Redwood security FAQ deck (drive link).
- 2026-02-18: Deep dive with CISO, infra lead, legal. Fireflies transcript + action items.
- 2026-02-25: Customer provided SOC 2 controls matrix and ISO scoping doc. Asked Redwood for mapping matrix (GAP analysis).
- 2026-03-01: SE POC runbook shared; customer requested proof of KMS key isolation and rotation policy.
- 2026-03-03: Network team requested explicit VPC peering diagram and CIDR ranges for staging vs prod.

Requested artifacts from Redwood (waiting):
- SOC 2 mapping: which Redwood controls map to Cobalt's CC/AIC criteria (evidence & artifact names).
- ISO 27001 Annex A control mapping + statement of applicability for Private VPC deployment.
- BAA draft for Private offering + KMS/HSM key custody language.
- PCI segmentation guidance doc for keeping Redwood Private outside of cardholder data environment.
- Example audit log export (format) and retention policy template.

POC plan (customer):
- 2-week sandbox in customer AWS account (VPC + KMS CMK) to validate key encryption flows + inference traffic egress.
- Run 50k inference/month simulation with PII/PHI payloads masked and unmasked to test redaction & logging.
- Security review & ATO checklist finalization in parallel.

Notes style: shorthand bullets, action owners annotated in timeline. Contact: CISO Maya Fernandez (maya.fernandez@cobalthdw.com).
